met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood now lies over north Bangladesh & adjoining Assam between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough from the cyclonic circulation over northeast Bihar to Telangana now runs from north Bangladesh & adjoining Assam to Telangana across Jharkhand, Odisha and Chhattisgarhbetween 3.1 & 16.6 km above mean sea level tilting northwestwards with height.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Haryana & neighbourhood now lies over northwest Uttar Pradesh at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Kerala coast at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the southeast Arabian Sea to South Interior Karnataka between 3.1 km & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Bihar & neighbourhoodbetween 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
